_comment: DATA_MODEL.md sidebar_sections 「セクションの中の並び順」 (2026-10-06): the order of conversations inside a sidebar / home section, the same on every client. The server keeps no order inside a section (sidebar_section_channels has none; channel_ids comes in no meaningful order), so the clients sort. names: channels (public / private) by name: the key is the name after NFKC, A-Z lower-cased and katakana (U+30A1-U+30F6) folded to hiragana, compared by UTF-16 code unit; equal keys by the raw name the same way, then by id. No locale collation (localeCompare / Collator differ per platform) and no natural number order ("10" before "2"). sections: a favorites or my-own section: its channels by name first, then its DMs and group DMs newest first (last_message_at, else created_at, compared as the server's text; equal times by id ascending). The default 「チャンネル」 and Times sections and 「チャンネルを探す」 use the same name order; 「ダイレクトメッセージ」 the same newest-first order after my own DM. Muting does not move a row; archived channels are not listed at all (not part of the order). Hand-written; desktop (tests/sidebarOrder.test.ts), iOS (SidebarOrderTests) and Android (SidebarOrderTest) read this file.

names.name: ASCII case is ignored, then upper case first
katakana among hiragana, half-width kana too
voiced kana after the plain one

sections.name: channels by name, then DMs newest first
a DM without messages by when it was made, equal times by id
recent activity does not move a channel
